Every perf budget of the engine at `319075e3f92b` (`StrataTests/Perf/Budgets.json`): what each metric measured on the reference machine and the budget its test enforces. The file says:

> Budgets of the perf tests (StrataTests/src/Perf, suites Perf.\* and PerfGPU.\*; Docs/DeveloperGuide.md, 'Perf tests'). Every metric a test checks (Perf:\:CheckBudgetConfirmed, CheckBudgetsConfirmed) or records (Perf:\:Record) needs an entry, or the test fails: &quot;&lt;Suite&gt;.&lt;Metric&gt;&quot;: { &quot;Measured&quot;: &lt;number&gt;, &quot;Budget&quot;: &lt;number&gt;, &quot;Unit&quot;: &lt;unit&gt;, &quot;Target&quot;: &lt;number&gt; } with a unit of &quot;ms&quot;, &quot;us&quot;, &quot;MB&quot;, &quot;count&quot; or &quot;ratio&quot; (of two measurements, e.g. a new way's time to an old way's). Lower is better: a test fails when it measures more than Budget in every attempt of its confirmed check (express rates as cost per item). Measured is the metric on the reference machine (Intel Core i7-13700K, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090, Windows 11, Release build, ctest --preset windows-release -L perf on a quiet machine); Budget is at most 1.5 times Measured (round down), or an acceptance limit below that. Target (optional) is a roadmap goal below Budget that the metric has not reached on every run: the budget is the gate, the target is reported with every check. A budget lowered to its target or below drops the target. Limits that tests check belong here, never in the test's code. Ratchet: budgets only go down. A change that makes a metric cheaper measures it again and lowers Measured and Budget in the same commit; a metric over its budget is a regression to fix, never a reason to raise the budget. A commit that adds or lowers a budget states the measured values in its message. A budget goes up only for a change of the machine, shown by the build of the commit that set it measuring as far over it on this machine, or once for a cost the owner accepted by name (Docs/DeveloperGuide.md, 'Perf tests'; Tools/PerfStability.py --propose-budgets --rebaseline). Provisional: a metric the reference machine has not measured yet (while it is away, Docs/Roadmap.md) has the entry &quot;&lt;Suite&gt;.&lt;Metric&gt;&quot;: { &quot;Unit&quot;: &lt;unit&gt;, &quot;Provisional&quot;: true, &quot;Target&quot;: &lt;number&gt; } (Target optional) and is measured and recorded, never checked, until the reference machine measures it and the entry gets its Measured and Budget. Numbers of other machines never go into an entry.
